Role Summary:

Become a part of the most exceptional and accomplished team in the Dubai Real Estate industry.

Experience as a Conveyancing Officer/Sales Progression Officer in Dubai is required.

Driving license is a must.

Available to start immediately.

To take overall responsibility for progression of all property sales promptly and efficiently from reservation to transfer stage of property, and liaise with seller, buyer, lenders, agents and Governing agencies to obtain relevant documents required and attending to their requirements.

Key Accountabilities:

  • Handle all enquiries from sellers or purchasers with regards to their transaction
  • Send the buyer/seller welcome email, followed up by an introductory phone call, explaining what sales progression is and how the sales progression officer will be supporting throughout the entire process
  • Coordinating with the clients via telephone and emails throughout the whole process, maintaining professionalism and etiquette throughout the collaboration with the clients
  • Informing all parties involved the required documentation and the duties needed to be settled before applying for the NOC, ensuring all documentation is correct
  • Update all relevant parties (including seller and buyer) on due payments and send periodic reports
  • Ensure all activities are prioritized upon raising aspirations, providing an excellent service to customers and meet their individual needs
  • Provide a comprehensive explanation to the seller and buyer for the whole entire process, including NOC requirements for the application and the final stage of the Transfer
  • Attending and supporting all NOC applications and Transfers with the clients, oversea the whole procedure, providing all the relevant documents on the client’s behalf’s
  • Liaise with all parties including seller, buyer, sales advisors, tenants, solicitors, financial institutions, property valuators and Developers, Trustee Offices to ensure smooth and quick completion of sales transactions
  • Coordinate with buyer/seller/banker their availability for evaluations of the property, NOC and Transfer appointments, then scheduling an appointment at the Developers/ Trustee Office
  • Achieve set sales targets and ensure properties are transferred efficiently
  • Coordinate with all related authorities, including but not limited to Developers, agencies, finance institutions, Government Bodies, and utility providers in order to obtain certificates or letters required for smooth transaction
  • Handle effectively all administrative documents related to sales once signed MOUs are obtained from both parties
  • Checking legal documents such as POAs, ensuring they are valid for the property transaction
  • Ensure all documentation is processed in accordance with set policies and procedures of the company and prevailing rules and requirements of Developers, Dubai Land Department
  • Collect relevant fees (deposit cheque, NOC fees, Sales Progression Fees) from buyer/seller
  • Provide breakdown for the payment schedule to buyer/seller that must be prepared for the final transfer, including all admin fees required from the Trustee office, instruct the buyer/seller to prepare “Manager’s Cheques” for the agency commission/ Dubai Land Department fees, as well as any service charges to be reimbursed to the seller from the buyer, rental deposits and annual rent to be reimbursed to the buyers.
  • Organize transfer; provide security deposit cheque back to buyer/seller, obtain acknowledgement receipt and receive payments and provide receipts

Job Description:

  • Obtain and maintain receipts from Dubai Land Authority to ensure all payments have been made by the buyer, on the date of the Transfer
  • Act as the main point of contact for the buyer/seller/lender throughout the whole process leading up to the NOC and transfer, and ensure all queries are answered effectively and efficiently
  • Ensuring the finance buyers are obtaining a final offer letter from their bank. Ensuring the financed seller is obtaining liability letter from their bank. Coordinating for the sellers outstanding mortgage lender to be discharged by the buyer before the NOC application 
  • Maintain the case sheet through which each step of the purchase process can be identified, managed and reported
  • Provide weekly reports to Head of sales progression
  • Ensure sales progression data is accurately captured on the CRM/Share drive
  • Ensure compliance at all times with company rules, values, policies, procedures, standing orders and financial regulations
  • Represent Zoya Ventures Real Estate in a professional and ethical manner, and maintain the highest standards of personal and professional integrity and conduct
  • Deal with any unforeseen obstacles in a quick efficient manner
  • Keeping clients satisfied at all times including handling any problematic circumstances that may occur
  • Coordinating with the drivers to collect cheques, money, signed documentation from the clients

Join Our Growing Team!

Do you have experience in luxury goods and a passion for real estate?

Do you thrive in dynamic environments and aspire to be a part of a team that values professionalism and excellence? If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you!

Our prestigious real estate firm, is seeking talented individuals to join our secondary team and contribute to our continued success.

Position: Property Consultant for Secondary Market
Location: Palm Jumeirah & Dubai Hills Estate, Dubai
Job Type: Full-time, Commission Only

Preferred Requirements:

  • Proven experience in luxury sales, preferably in Dubai.
  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
  • Strong understanding of the Dubai real estate market.
  • Ability to build and maintain client relationships.
  • Motivated, ambitious, and results-driven.
  • Presentable with a professional image.
  • Valid UAE driving license.
  • Financially stable for at least 6 Months.

Responsibilities:

  • Identify and pursue opportunities for luxury property sales.
  • Assist clients in buying, selling, and renting properties.
  • Conduct market research and stay updated on industry trends.
  • Provide exceptional customer service and guidance throughout the sales process.
  • Collaborate effectively with team members to achieve targets.

Benefits Zoya Ventures Real Estate Offer:

  • An experienced team with 20+ years of experience in Real Estate industry.
  • In-house Marketing team with the biggest budget on the market.
  • Access to a 16-year client database.
  • In-house Academy (training).
  • Best packages for Property Finder and Bayut, granting access to Property Monitor and Genie Map.
  • A lead pool.
  • An in-house Conveyancing Department, Property Management and Engineering team, Prime Stay (holiday Homes Company), Mortgage and Finance Department.
  • 4 offices in Dubai (2 offices for Secondary market team).
  • Residence Visa and RERA license (paid by the company).
  • Medical Insurance.
  • Mobile Phone including a Sim Card with minutes and data.
  • A Listing Team.
  • Admin support.
  • Attractive commission split and slab structure.
  • Supportive and friendly culture.

If you're ready to take your career to the next level and be a part of an innovative and ambitious team, we want to hear from you! Join us in shaping the future of luxury real estate in Dubai.

Role Summary:

As an administrative Coordinator at Zoya Ventures Real Estate, you will be a vital part of the administration in the most successful and progressive real estate agencies in the UAE, aiding our departments with their administrative needs, while adhering to company policies and procedures, in one of the world's most vibrant and competitive marketplaces. Your position is critical in ensuring that internal and external communications are maintained, with the highest standards of detail and quality. This role necessitates a thorough knowledge of email etiquette and industry standards.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Answer and direct phone calls.
  • Organize and schedule appointments.
  • Plan meetings and take detailed minutes of the meeting, write and distribute emails, correspondence memos, letters, faxes, and forms.
  • Assist in the preparation of regularly scheduled reports. 
  • Develop and maintain a filing system. 
  • Update and maintain office policies and procedures. 
  • Provide general support to visitors.
  • Act as the point of contact for internal and external clients Liaise with executive and senior administrative assistants to handle requests and queries from senior managers

Qualifications and Skills Required:

  • Proven secretary work experience, as an Office Secretary or Administrative Assistant.
  • Proficient with MS Office and data programs.
  • Experience using office equipment, like printers and scanners.
  • Typing speed and accuracy.
  • Excellent knowledge of correct spelling, grammar, and punctuation.
  • Attention to detail.
  • Confidentiality.
  • Organization skills, with an ability to stay focused on assigned tasks.
  • High school diploma / Diploma; additional secretarial training or certification will be an asset.
  • Proficient in English: Written and spoken.

Role Summary

As an Operations Manager at Zoya Ventures Real Estate, you will be a vital part of the Operations Department, responsible to oversee contact center quality assurance programs and establish standards governing customer interactions in one of the most successful and progressive real estate agencies in the UAE.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Set quality standards for all customer interactions
  • Develop effective quality assurance & compliance processes 
  • Implement and deliver coaching and continuous improvement frameworks
  • Manage and update internal knowledge management systems in line with quality standards 
  • Develop effective onboarding and training content for new and existing CX Consultant 
  • Organising quality audits, identifying training needs, and analysing results to support the wider operation
  • Creating analytical reports, linking to quality performance and key KPIs to define and implement relevant action plans
  • Passionate about organizational and customer success 
  • Adapt and succeed in a changing environment 
  • Collaborating with other functions to deliver the best results for the company and the customer

Qualifications and Skills Required:

  • Proficient in English & Arabic: Written & Spoken
  • 3 Years experience in same or similar role in UAE
  • Demonstrated ability to problem-solve and deep-dive into complex challenges, leveraging data as a key parameter for decision-making 
  • Stellar project management and execution skills to navigate project milestones 
  • Proven leadership, organizational and team management skills within the domain of customer operations/Technical support management 
  • Experience within a SaaS/Marketplace environment is preferred 
  • A good understanding of Service/Quality frameworks like COPC, Six Sigma or others
  • Experience of driving change initiatives in a service-based environment
  • Bachelor’s in Operations Management, Business Management or related field

Role Summary:

As an Executive Assistant at Zoya Ventures Real Estate, you will be a vital part of the Management Department of the company, responsible for managing the schedules and communications of key company executives. Your duties include prioritizing emails and phone calls, gathering documents to prepare for meetings and coordinating travel arrangements, in one of the most successful and progressive real estate agencies in the UAE. 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Providing administrative assistance, such as writing and editing emails, drafting memos, and preparing communications & presentations on the executive’s behalf 
  • Maintaining comprehensive and accurate records 
  • Performing minor accounting duties 
  • Organizing meetings, including scheduling, sending reminders, and organizing catering when necessary & answering phone calls in a polite and professional manner 
  • Managing the executive’s calendar, including making appointments and prioritizing the most sensitive matters 
  • Act as the point of contact among executives, employees, clients and other external partners & manage information flow in a timely and accurate manner & make travel and accommodation arrangements 
  • Oversee the performance of other clerical staff 
  • Take minutes during meetings & Screen and direct phone calls and distribute correspondence 
  • Organize and maintain the office filing system

Qualifications and Skills Required:

  • Outstanding organizational and time management skills 
  • Excellent proficiency in English & Arabic - Written & Spoken 
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to multitask 
  • Problem-solving and decision making 
  • Proactivity and self-direction Interpersonal skills 
  • 2 Years work experience as an Executive Assistant, Personal Assistant or similar role 
  • Excellent MS Office & Google Services knowledge 
  • Outstanding organizational and time management skills 
  • Discretion and confidentiality 
  • High School degree; PA diploma or certification is a plus

Role Summary:

Key Responsibilities:

Position Overview:

The Quality Assurance Officer will be responsible for ensuring that all communication between agents and clients meets the company’s high standards of service, compliance, and professionalism. This role involves monitoring interactions, ensuring accurate lead management, handling customer feedback, and improving overall customer satisfaction. The position also requires effective handling of client complaints, resolution management, and reporting on all findings to the necessary managerial staff.

Key Responsibilities:

Call Monitoring & Evaluation:

  • Conduct daily random quality checks on calls between agents and clients, ensuring that conversations meet the company’s standards and regulations.
  • Ensure agents follow the correct procedures for lead management and escalate any deviations to the appropriate parties, including the line manager and department director.

Lead Management:

  • Review all "junked" or discarded leads to verify the client's disinterest in investment, buying, or selling.
  • Reassign leads that qualify as potential opportunities back to agents based on instructions from the CEO or head of sales.

Net Promoter Score (NPS) and Feedback:

  • Conduct NPS calls with clients to rate their satisfaction with services (on a 0-10 scale) and record all feedback into the CRM system.
  • Analyze NPS results and provide reports to management for action and improvement planning.

Client Feedback Management:

  • Oversee Google reviews and other client feedback on service platforms. Respond to reviews professionally and ensure follow-up actions are taken to resolve issues or improve services.
  • Manage and maintain a positive online presence by addressing negative reviews and ensuring constructive engagement with clients.

Custom Call Checks:

  • Perform additional call quality checks as requested by the line manager or department manager, focusing on specific campaigns, agents, or types of interactions.

Complaint Handling:

  • Handle all incoming client complaints, ensuring a resolution is achieved within 24 hours.
  • Create and maintain detailed incident reports for each complaint to track issues, resolutions, and patterns that may require further investigation or process improvement.

Reporting & Data Analysis:

  • Generate comprehensive quality assurance reports that highlight call performance, NPS trends, lead handling efficiency, and client feedback trends.
  • Provide actionable insights and suggestions for continuous improvement to the management team.

Collaboration:

  • Work closely with sales, customer service, and management teams to ensure all procedures are followed, and all client interactions are of the highest quality.
  • Assist in training new agents based on identified areas of improvement from call monitoring and feedback collection.

Requirements:

Experience:

  • 1-2 years of experience in quality assurance, particularly within customer service or sales environments.
  • Proven track record of conducting professional calls, campaign management, and handling customer feedback.

Skills:

  • Strong English verbal and written communication skills with the ability to interact professionally with clients and internal teams.
  • Proficient in reporting, data analysis, and incident documentation.
  • Familiarity with CRM systems and online feedback platforms (e.g., Google Reviews).
  • Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, for data reporting and analysis.

Competencies:

  • Strong attention to detail and analytical mindset.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks under pressure and meet deadlines.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills with a focus on customer satisfaction.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in the real estate or sales industry.
  • Familiarity with NPS methodology and feedback analysis.
  • Strong knowledge of regulatory standards related to sales and customer communication.
